entity: Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
stance_basis: listed among agencies endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments
summary: The Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, represented by Commissioner of Agriculture Doyle Conner, reviewed the draft Environmental Impact Statement on off-road vehicle use on public lands. The agency checked no items requiring comment on the standard review form and indicated it does not wish to review the final environmental impact statement, signaling no objections. It was subsequently listed by the Florida Division of State Planning as one of the agencies endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments.
complaint_summary: The Florida Division of State Planning's cover letter identifies the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services as one of several agencies that endorsed the proposal or offered no adverse comments.

statement.text:
